root.title: Project Management Methodology
root.content: A structured approach to planning, executing, and closing projects successfully.

node.title: Planning Phase
node.content: The initial phase where project scope, objectives, and resources are defined.

child.title: Scope Definition
child.content: Clearly defining what is included and excluded from the project.

child.title: Resource Allocation
child.content: Identifying and assigning necessary human and material resources.

child.title: Timeline Creation
child.content: Developing a realistic schedule with milestones and deadlines.

child.title: Risk Assessment
child.content: Identifying potential risks and developing mitigation strategies.

node.title: Execution Phase
node.content: The phase where project work is performed according to the plan.

child.title: Task Management
child.content: Coordinating and monitoring individual tasks and activities.

child.title: Daily Standups
child.content: Brief team meetings to sync on progress and blockers.

child.title: Progress Tracking
child.content: Monitoring task completion and timeline adherence.

child.title: Quality Control
child.content: Ensuring deliverables meet specified standards and requirements.

child.title: Communication Management
child.content: Maintaining clear communication channels with stakeholders.

node.title: Monitoring & Control
node.content: Continuous oversight to ensure project stays on track.

child.title: Performance Metrics
child.content: Key indicators to measure project health and progress.

child.title: Change Management
child.content: Process for handling scope changes and modifications.

child.title: Issue Resolution
child.content: Systematic approach to identifying and resolving problems.

node.title: Closure Phase
node.content: Formal completion of project activities and handover.

child.title: Deliverable Handover
child.content: Transfer of completed work products to stakeholders.

child.title: Documentation
child.content: Completion of project documentation and lessons learned.

child.title: Team Release
child.content: Formal release of project team members to other assignments.

child.title: Post-Project Review
child.content: Evaluation of project success and areas for improvement.
